tx.Arte digital e investigación: la convive: Digital art and research: the coexistence of humanity, nature and artificial systems.
tx.Todos los días, en distintos horarios, v: Every day, at different times, I return to the same place: my city's shoreline. I photograph the wetland, the water, the sky, the animals and the traces we leave on the landscape.
tx.Además de la imagen registro otra capa d: Beyond the image, I record another layer of the landscape: temperature, humidity, wind, pressure and rainfall. In Paisaje de Datos, these records begin to alter the photograph, which stops being an end point and becomes the first layer of a digital memory in transformation.
tx.Cada dato, una pregunta. Cada imagen, un: Every piece of data, a question. Every image, a memory.
